title: Randomised, Double-Blind, Crossover Study with Inhaled LABA, LAMA, and their Combination AERO-007
official: Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, 14-Day Treatment, 2-Period Crossover Trial Evaluating the Lung Function Response After Treatment with Inhaled LABA and LAMA Monotherapies and Their Combination AERO-007 Administered via Nebulization in Participants with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) (AERODUO-2 Trial)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the bronchodilator response of LABA (AERO-001, indacaterol) and LAMA (AERO-002, glycopyrrolate) components of AERO-007 following 14 days of treatment in participants with moderate to severe COPD
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female aged 40 to 75 years, inclusive, at the time of informed consent
2. Participants must agree not to donate semen or ova/oocytes from the time of informed  consent and for 30 days following the last administered dose
3. Willing and able to provide written informed consent
4. Clinical diagnosis of COPD according to the Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung  Disease [GOLD] Report, 2026 for at least 12 months prior to Screening Visit 1
5. Post-bronchodilator spirometry (after 10 to 30 minutes following 4 puffs of  salbutamol/albuterol via metered dose inhaler [MDI] with a spacer) at Screening Visit 2  demonstrating the following:  • FEV1 ≥40 and ≤ 80% of predicted normal (using the Global Lung Function Initiative  [GLI] 2012 reference values)  • FEV1/forced vital capacity (FVC) ratio < 0.70  • ≥ 150 mL increase from pre-bronchodilator FEV1 following 4 puffs of  salbutamol/albuterol
6. Ability to change current COPD therapy and discontinue long-acting bronchodilators, if  applicable, for the duration of the trial and short-acting bronchodilators for 8 hours prior to  dosing at each Treatment Visit
7. Current or former-smokers with at least 10 pack-year smoking history (eg, at least 1 pack/day  for 10 years, 10 packs/day for 1 year)
8. Ability to perform reproducible spirometry according to the American Thoracic Society  (ATS)/European Respiratory Society (ERS) guidelines
9. Female participants of childbearing potential must not be pregnant, breast feeding or lactating  and heterosexual female participants of childbearing potential must agree to use, with their  partner, a male condom plus an approved method of highly effective birth control from the  time of informed consent and for 30 days following the last administered dose
10. Female participants of childbearing potential must have a negative serum or urine pregnancy  test at Screening Visit 1 and a negative urine pregnancy test prior to dosing at each Treatment  Visit
11. Male participants who are sexually active with a female partner of childbearing potential  must use, with their partner, a male condom plus an approved method of highly effective  contraception from the time of informed consent and for 30 days following the last  administered dose
Exclusion criteria:
1. Current evidence or recent history of significant comorbidities; including cardiovascular  disease (such as myocardial infarction, cardiac failure, uncontrolled hypertension, or life threatening arrhythmias), uncontrolled diabetes, neurologic, psychiatric, hepatic, renal,  immunological, or hematological conditions within the last 6 months prior to Screening Visit  1
2. Current or recent history of medical conditions that are contraindicated for use of an inhaled  LAMA (such as urinary retention or bladder neck obstruction type symptoms, prostatic  hypertrophy, or narrow-angle glaucoma) within the last 6 months prior to Screening Visit 1
3. Current or recent history (previous 12 months) of excessive use or abuse of alcohol (males  >21 units per week and females >14 units per week)
4. Current evidence or history (within the past 2 years) of abusing legal drugs or use of illegal  drugs or substances
5. Donation of 450 mL of blood within 8 weeks of Screening Visit 1
6. Major surgery (requiring general anaesthesia) within 6 weeks prior to Screening Visit 1, or  planned surgery through the EOS Visit
7. History of malignancy of any organ system, except for localized skin cancers, within 5 years  prior to Screening Visit 1
8. History of intolerance or hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients in the formulation for  AERO-001, AERO-002, AERO-007, or other aerosol medications
9. Participation in another investigational drug trial within 30 days of the last dose, 5 half-lives  or twice the duration of the biological effect, whichever is longer, prior to Screening Visit 1
10. History or high risk of noncompliance with trial visits and procedures or unsuitable for entry  into the trial at the discretion of the Investigator
11. Positive serum hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis C virus (HCV) antibody or  human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) type 1 and/or 2 antibodies at Screening Visit 1
12. Lower respiratory tract infection within 6 weeks prior to Screening Visit 1
13. Recent history of hospitalization due to an exacerbation of airway disease or acute worsening  of COPD requiring antibiotic or systemic corticosteroid treatment within 6 months prior to  Screening Visit 1
14. Other respiratory disorders: Current diagnosis of predominant asthma, lung cancer,  bronchiectasis, interstitial lung disease, tuberculosis, pulmonary hypertension, or other non specific pulmonary diseases
15. Prior lung volume reduction surgery or history of chest/lung irradiation
16. Daily oxygen therapy for > 12 hours per day
17. Body mass index >35 kg/m2
18. Abnormal and clinically significant 12-lead ECG findings at Screening Visit 1
